summary: RC 115f698 (clean checkout, 0 local changes) is a coherent 3-service system in CODE: Vite/React SPA -> Spring Boot 3.3.5 monolith (MySQL+Flyway, 834 main classes, 3621 JUnit tests, 0 real failures, 22 MySQL-Testcontainers tests skipped) -> FastAPI influora-ai (Claude/Gemini/Sarvam; 874 pytest, 873 pass + 1 timing-flaky that passes in isolation), with JWKS/ES256 service tokens, HMAC internal calls, ShedLock on every @Scheduled job, a single money-in path (Razorpay top-up webhook + hourly WalletTopUpReconciliationJob) and fail-closed startup validation of secrets and AI URLs. As a PRODUCTION SYSTEM it is not yet coherent: (1) the deployment architecture is fragmented - three committed topologies (hostinger compose, utho compose, utho-shared compose) plus a live box that matches none of them; runtime probes show the live SPA is a hand-built static bundle with a same-origin /api proxy that no committed config defines, zero security headers, while the CI-published web image bakes https://api.influora.in which live serves with a CN=snapsby.com certificate; (2) every committed prod compose omits the Redis host for influora-api although @EnableCaching+spring-data-redis make @Cacheable (HSN/SAC code lookup used by invoice generation, admin pulse, discovery facets) hit localhost:6379 - the repo's own EscrowReleaseGateIntegrationTest documents the RedisConnectionFailureException and masks it; (3) the backend runs an out-of-OSS-support Spring Boot 3.3.5 / Tomcat 10.1.31 (OSV: 32 Tomcat advisories) and influora-ai pins pyjwt 2.10.1 / python-multipart 0.0.20 with known advisories; (4) state is per-process (OAuth state, rate limits, HMAC nonce cache, single uvicorn worker) so the system is single-instance only; (5) images publish to :latest on every main push with no test gate; no DB backups, no metrics/alerting. Verdict: a well-engineered collection of features on a single-node architecture whose code is largely production-grade but whose deploy/config layer is not reproducible from the repo - NOT go-live ready until the P1 items are closed.

questions.question: Can the production stack be reproduced from the RC alone (is what runs live defined in the repo)?
questions.why_it_matters: If live is hand-assembled, no audit of the RC proves what users get, and a redeploy from the repo can break production.
questions.answer: No. Live https://influora.in serves a static SPA (nginx/1.26.3 Ubuntu) whose bundle bakes https://influora.in/api/v1 and proxies /api/v1 same-origin to Spring; no committed nginx/Caddy config provides a same-origin /api proxy (deploy/utho/nginx-influora.conf:59-73 sends the apex to Caddy:8080, and deploy/utho/Caddyfile routes {$ROOT_DOMAIN}/{$APP_DOMAIN} only to frontend:80). The CI image path (publish-images.yml default vite_api_base_url=https://api.influora.in/api/v1) targets a host that live serves with CN=snapsby.com.
questions.evidence: curl https://influora.in/api/v1/admin/auth/me -> 401 JSON from Spring; live bundle /assets/index-CuJLpqhw.js contains 'https://influora.in/api/v1' x3 and 0 api.influora.in; openssl s_client api.influora.in -> subject=CN=snapsby.com; deploy/utho/Caddyfile lines 7-14; docker/nginx.conf.template:141-143 (try_files only, no proxy_pass).
questions.remaining_uncertainty: The live compose (/usr/local/App/docker-compose.prod.yml per application-prod.yml comment) is not in the repo, so exact live backend env is unknown.

questions.question: Does every ${VAR} without a default in application*.yml get supplied by each committed deploy compose?
questions.why_it_matters: A missing required var aborts boot (PlaceholderResolutionException); a missing optional var silently degrades a feature.
questions.answer: Yes for the three prod composes (utho, utho-shared, hostinger): all 12 required vars (APP_ENV, SPRING_DATASOURCE_*, 5 AI base URLs, VOICE_AI_BASE_URL, MEERA_PUBLIC_CHAT_URL, META_REDIRECT_URI) are set. deploy/hostinger/docker-compose.test.yml omits MEERA_PUBLIC_CHAT_URL but sets INFLUORA_MEERA_STREAM_PUBLICCHATURL, which relaxed-binds to the same property (higher precedence), so it still boots. Stale comment in application-prod.yml:74-77 claims utho-shared/test lack CREATOR_COPILOT_AI_BASE_URL/VOICE_AI_BASE_URL - no longer true.
questions.evidence: Python diff of all ${VAR} in influora-api/src/main/resources/application*.yml vs the influora-api environment: map of each compose (160 placeholders; results: 0 REQUIRED-MISSING on 3 prod composes).
questions.remaining_uncertainty: Relaxed-binding claims for INFLUORA_* keys are from Spring Boot semantics, not a boot run.

questions.question: Are there settings the app needs that NO yml placeholder or compose supplies (hidden dependencies)?
questions.why_it_matters: Hidden defaults (localhost) are the classic 'works in dev, dies in prod' class.
questions.answer: Yes: spring.data.redis.host. pom.xml has spring-boot-starter-data-redis, RedisCacheConfig has @EnableCaching, no application*.yml sets spring.data.redis.*, and none of the 3 prod composes pass SPRING_DATA_REDIS_HOST to influora-api (only docker-compose.test.yml:89-90 does). The API will use localhost:6379 inside its container.
questions.evidence: grep of application*.yml (no redis key); compose env diff; influora-api/src/test/java/com/influora/service/EscrowReleaseGateIntegrationTest.java:75-87 states the first @Cacheable call throws RedisConnectionFailureException without Redis and forces spring.cache.type=none.
questions.remaining_uncertainty: Live compose may set it; not observable without authenticated calls.

questions.question: Is the payment architecture single-path and reconcilable?
questions.why_it_matters: Money that enters via Razorpay must be credited exactly once even if a webhook is lost.
questions.answer: Mostly yes in code. Money enters only via wallet top-up (Razorpay order + signature-verified webhook RazorpayWebhookController:88-155); escrow funds from wallet balance, not a second checkout (EscrowService ~line 322-333 applyFunding(hold,null)); WalletTopUpReconciliationJob (hourly, @SchedulerLock) asks the gateway for missed top-ups; payouts debit before RazorpayX and PayoutOrphanedDebitSweepJob sweeps. Coupling risk: the Razorpay account is shared with another product, so ESCROW_NOT_FOUND/TOPUP_NOT_FOUND receipts are acknowledged 200 (RazorpayWebhookController:200-217).
questions.evidence: Code read of RazorpayWebhookController, EscrowService, WalletTopUpReconciliationJob; ShedLock scan shows all 24 @Scheduled methods locked; backend suite 3621 tests green.
questions.remaining_uncertainty: No live payment run in this audit; test keys only in generate-env.sh placeholders.

questions.question: Can the backend scale beyond one instance?
questions.why_it_matters: Go-live traffic spikes or a rolling deploy need 2+ instances.
questions.answer: No. OAuth state (MetaOAuthStateStore:24, ShopifyOAuthStateStore), auth rate limit windows (AuthRateLimitFilter:283) and HMAC replay nonces (NonceCache:24) are ConcurrentHashMaps; a second instance breaks OAuth callbacks and halves rate limits/replay protection. influora-ai runs uvicorn --workers 1 (influora-ai/Dockerfile CMD). Redis runs with --save '' --appendonly no. Scheduled jobs are ShedLock-safe.
questions.evidence: grep of security/ and integration/*/oauth; compose redis command; Dockerfile CMD.
questions.remaining_uncertainty: Single-instance may be an accepted launch posture.

questions.question: Are the three services built/tested/published with a gate, and is the deployed artifact traceable to a commit?
questions.why_it_matters: Without a gate a red commit can ship; with :latest there is no rollback identity.
questions.answer: No gate: .github/workflows/publish-images.yml builds and pushes api/ai/web on every push to main (paths filter) with no needs: on backend-tests/ai-tests/frontend-checks; api image built with -DskipTests. All compose files pull :latest. ai-tests.yml runs Python 3.11 while influora-ai/Dockerfile uses python:3.13.
questions.evidence: publish-images.yml (on.push main; jobs api/ai/web; no needs); deploy/*/docker-compose*.yml image: ...:latest; ai-tests.yml:33 python-version '3.11'.
questions.remaining_uncertainty: Branch protection rules on GitHub may require checks before merge (not visible in repo).

questions.question: Are the runtime platforms and dependencies supported and free of known advisories?
questions.why_it_matters: Internet-facing payment system on unpatched Tomcat/Spring is a security exposure.
questions.answer: No. Spring Boot 3.3.5 (OSS support ended mid-2025) with BOM-managed Tomcat 10.1.31 (OSV: 32 advisories), spring-security-core 6.3.4 (2), spring-web 6.1.14 (1), spring-boot (2). influora-ai: pyjwt 2.10.1 (13 OSV ids), python-multipart 0.0.20 (14 OSV ids). npm prod tree: 1 high (browserslist via autoprefixer in dependencies), 2 moderate.
questions.evidence: pom.xml:8-10 parent 3.3.5, no version overrides in <properties>; ~/.m2 spring-boot-dependencies-3.3.5.pom confirms 6.1.14/6.3.4/10.1.31; OSV querybatch; npm audit --omit=dev.
questions.remaining_uncertainty: Exploitability of each advisory against this configuration not assessed (Kabir's lane).

questions.question: Is the AI service boundary safe and observable?
questions.why_it_matters: influora-ai holds provider keys and spends money per call.
questions.answer: Auth is per-route (verify_token / verify_creator_token / trend-tag bearer secret); all routers register in the RC (runtime import listed 14 routes). But ai.influora.in publicly serves /docs, /redoc and /openapi.json (live 200) exposing internal route schemas; router import failures are swallowed (main.py:79-107) while /healthz and /readyz stay green; trend_tag rate limiter keys on request.client.host which behind Caddy is the proxy IP.
questions.evidence: python import of app.main (routes list); curl https://ai.influora.in/docs and /openapi.json -> 200; main.py FastAPI(...) without docs_url=None; routes/trend_tag.py rate limit on request.client.host.
questions.remaining_uncertainty: Whether uvicorn forwarded-allow-ips is set on live.

questions.question: Is there observability sufficient to detect a stranded payment or a dead AI route in production?
questions.why_it_matters: Reconciliation WARNs are useless if nobody is alerted.
questions.answer: Minimal. Actuator exposes only health (application.yml:121-128); no Micrometer registry, Sentry or OTel in pom/requirements/package.json; logback is plain key=value console with correlationId per request but no propagation to influora-ai; ErrorLogService/ClientErrorController persist errors to DB. No alert channel exists in code.
questions.evidence: logback-spring.xml; grep micrometer/prometheus/sentry/opentelemetry -> none; grep X-Correlation-Id in AI clients -> none.
questions.remaining_uncertainty: External uptime monitors may exist outside the repo.

questions.question: Is there a database backup and restore path for the ledger?
questions.why_it_matters: Wallet/escrow ledger loss is unrecoverable financial data loss.
questions.answer: Not in the repo. No backup service, cron or mysqldump in deploy/**, scripts/** or .github/**; MySQL lives on a single named volume on a VPS shared with another product (docker-compose.utho-shared.yml header).
questions.evidence: grep -i 'mysqldump|backup' over deploy scripts .github -> only a vhost-config backup in install-ai-vhost.sh.
questions.remaining_uncertainty: Provider-level VPS snapshots may exist (not verifiable read-only).

questions.question: Are package boundaries enforced (no cycles, layering respected)?
questions.why_it_matters: Cycles make the 58k-line service layer hard to change safely.
questions.answer: No enforcement and several cycles: service->web.dto 328 imports while web->service 148; common->service (GlobalExceptionHandler->ErrorLogService); security->service (PlanGateFilter, AnalyticsUsageCapInterceptor, InternalServiceTokenFilter, OnBehalfAuthResolver); integration<->service (RazorpayWebhookController lives in integration and calls EscrowService/WalletTopUpService). No ArchUnit; the only architecture test is InfoBarrierTest (source scan for one barrier). Service-level cycle: API->AI (chat) and AI->API (SPRING_INTERNAL_BASE_URL tools, JWKS).
questions.evidence: Python import-graph over influora-api/src/main/java/com/influora (top-level package edges).
questions.remaining_uncertainty: Cycles are structural debt, not a runtime defect.

questions.question: How many FE API layers exist and do FE types match backend DTOs?
questions.why_it_matters: Divergent clients and lenient binding hide contract drift until runtime.
questions.answer: Three layers: src/lib/api.ts (7037 lines), src/lib/meera-api.ts (905), src/admin/services/api-contracts.ts + src/admin/utils/auditLogger.ts (own relative '/api/v1/admin' base). ci/dto-drift-check.py passes but checks only 5 TS/Java pairs against ~403 Java records; Jackson FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES is Boot-default false and 24 classes add ignoreUnknown=true. tsc --noEmit on the RC exits 0.
questions.evidence: wc; grep API_BASE; python ci/dto-drift-check.py -> 'OK 5 pairs'; npx tsc exit 0.
questions.remaining_uncertainty: Per-endpoint drift is other agents' lane (Vikram/Ananya).

questions.question: Does the RC build and test green?
questions.why_it_matters: A red RC cannot be released.
questions.answer: Backend: 3621 tests, 0 failures; 1 error was an artifact of my scratch-copy layout (ShopifyPropertiesBindingTest reads ../deploy) and passes 8/8 once deploy/ is present; 22 skipped = all MySQL Testcontainers classes (Docker unavailable) so MySQL-only constraint behaviour is unverified here. AI: 873 passed, 1 skipped, 1 timing-flaky (test_f14_a_slow_tool... passes alone). FE: tsc clean. Caveat: local Python has anthropic 0.125.0 not the pinned 0.42.0.
questions.evidence: mvn -o -B test on a scratch copy of influora-api; pytest on a scratch copy of influora-ai; npx tsc --noEmit on RC.
questions.remaining_uncertainty: Testcontainers suite and vitest not executed in this pass.

questions.question: Does the repo TECH-STACK.md match the code, and does the org-level stack (Next.js/Prisma/NextAuth/Vercel) apply?
questions.why_it_matters: Agents following the wrong stack doc generate wrong code.
questions.answer: Repo TECH-STACK.md (context only) says React 19 + Vite 6 + Spring Boot 3.3.5 + FastAPI - matches package.json/pom.xml/requirements.txt. The agent-persona stack (Next.js 14, Prisma, NextAuth, Vercel/Railway) does not apply at all. Leftover Next.js files remain: next.config.mjs (ignoreBuildErrors: true), next-env.d.ts; plus pnpm-lock.yaml beside package-lock.json.
questions.evidence: package.json scripts use vite; Dockerfile runs npx vite build; next.config.mjs present with no next dependency.

findings.title: influora-api Redis host never wired in any prod compose: @Cacheable paths (invoice HSN/SAC lookup, admin pulse, discovery facets) hit localhost:6379
findings.evidence: pom.xml:64-65 spring-boot-starter-data-redis; config/RedisCacheConfig.java @EnableCaching (no CacheErrorHandler anywhere in src/main); no spring.data.redis.* in application.yml/-prod/-dev; influora-api environment: in deploy/utho/docker-compose.utho.yml, docker-compose.utho-shared.yml and deploy/hostinger/docker-compose.hostinger.yml has no SPRING_DATA_REDIS_HOST (only deploy/hostinger/docker-compose.test.yml:89-90 sets it); the api service depends_on redis. The repo's own test influora-api/src/test/java/com/influora/service/EscrowReleaseGateIntegrationTest.java:75-87 states that without Redis the first @Cacheable call throws RedisConnectionFailureException, and masks it with spring.cache.type=none. @Cacheable callers: HsnSacCodeService.resolveCode (used by billing/InvoiceService:258 and CampaignServiceInvoiceService), AdminDashboardStatsCache:71, CreatorDiscoveryFacetsCache:61.
findings.impact: Deployed from the repo, invoice generation (subscription + campaign GST invoices), admin dashboard pulse and creator discovery facets would 500 on first call. Tests are green because every test path disables or never reaches the Redis cache.
findings.recommended_fix: Add SPRING_DATA_REDIS_HOST: redis and SPRING_DATA_REDIS_PORT: '6379' to the influora-api env of all three prod composes (and a ${SPRING_DATA_REDIS_HOST} placeholder in application-prod.yml with no default so a miss fails boot), and register a CacheErrorHandler that logs and falls through so a Redis outage degrades to DB reads instead of 500s.
findings.verification_required: Boot the utho compose locally, call GET /admin/dashboard pulse and an invoice-generating path; confirm no RedisConnectionFailureException. Check the live box env for SPRING_DATA_REDIS_HOST.
findings.reproduction: Start influora-api with the utho compose env map and no SPRING_DATA_REDIS_HOST; invoke any HsnSacCodeService.resolveCode path.

findings.title: Deployment topology not reproducible from the repo: live edge/SPA differ from every committed config; CI web image targets a host serving the wrong certificate
findings.evidence: Runtime (read-only GETs, 2026-09-19): https://influora.in/api/v1/health -> 200 from Spring; https://influora.in/api/v1/admin/auth/me -> 401 JSON (same-origin /api proxy exists live); live bundle /assets/index-CuJLpqhw.js bakes 'https://influora.in/api/v1' (3x), no api.influora.in; https://api.influora.in presents CN=snapsby.com (SAN snapsby.com, www.snapsby.com) -> TLS failure; live https://influora.in/ returns NO Content-Security-Policy, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options (the SPA is served by host nginx, not the committed docker/nginx.conf.template which defines them at lines 79-135). Code: .github/workflows/publish-images.yml web job default vite_api_base_url 'https://api.influora.in/api/v1'; deploy/utho/generate-env.sh sets API_DOMAIN=api.influora.in, feeding INFLUORA_API_PUBLIC_URL used by ShopifyWebhookRegistrar, Msg91EmailClient, CreatorCouponService; deploy/utho/Caddyfile routes ROOT/APP domains only to frontend:80 and docker/nginx.conf.template:141-143 has only try_files, so src/admin/services/admin-session.ts:36 relative '/api/v1/admin' has no proxy in any committed topology.
findings.location: .github/workflows/publish-images.yml (web job inputs); deploy/utho/Caddyfile:7-14; deploy/utho/nginx-influora.conf:55-73; docker/nginx.conf.template:141-143; src/admin/services/admin-session.ts:36; .env.production (VITE_API_BASE_URL)
findings.impact: Redeploying the published influora-web image breaks every API call (cert mismatch) and the admin console (no /api proxy); Shopify webhooks/email links built from API_DOMAIN point at a snapsby-certified host; the live SPA ships without clickjacking/CSP protection on payment pages; what is audited in the RC is not what users run.
findings.recommended_fix: Pick ONE topology and commit it: either (a) same-origin - add a location /api/ proxy_pass to Spring in docker/nginx.conf.template and the host vhost, set API_DOMAIN/INFLUORA_API_PUBLIC_URL and publish-images defaults to https://influora.in/api/v1; or (b) issue a cert + vhost for api.influora.in. Serve the SPA from the CI image (or copy docker/nginx.conf.template's header block into the host vhost). Commit the live compose (/usr/local/App/docker-compose.prod.yml) and delete the unused hostinger/utho variants.
findings.verification_required: After fix: curl -I https://influora.in shows CSP/HSTS/XFO; openssl s_client for whichever API host is used shows a matching CN; deploy the CI image to staging and complete an admin login.
affected_features: All SPA->API calls in image-based deploys
Email links using API public URL
findings.reproduction: curl -sI https://influora.in/ | grep -i content-security ; openssl s_client -connect api.influora.in:443 -servername api.influora.in | openssl x509 -noout -subject

findings.title: Backend platform out of OSS support with known advisories: Spring Boot 3.3.5 / Tomcat 10.1.31 / Spring Security 6.3.4 / Spring Web 6.1.14
findings.evidence: influora-api/pom.xml:8-10 parent spring-boot-starter-parent 3.3.5; <properties> overrides only java.version and aws.sdk.version; local BOM spring-boot-dependencies-3.3.5.pom -> spring-framework 6.1.14, spring-security 6.3.4, tomcat 10.1.31. OSV querybatch: tomcat-embed-core 10.1.31 = 32 advisories (e.g. GHSA-23hv-mwm6-g8jf), spring-security-core 6.3.4 = 2 (GHSA-q3v6-hm2v-pw99, GHSA-vxf7-qj7q-83fh), spring-web 6.1.14 = 1 (GHSA-6r3c-xf4w-jxjm), spring-boot 3.3.5 = 2 (GHSA-rc42-6c7j-7h5r, GHSA-wwpq-f5c3-7hvx).
findings.impact: Internet-facing payments API runs on a servlet container and security framework with published advisories and no further OSS patches on the 3.3 line.
findings.recommended_fix: Upgrade to a supported Spring Boot line (3.5.x) in one PR, rerun the 3621-test suite plus the Testcontainers suite; as an interim, override tomcat.version/spring-security.version in <properties> to the latest patched 10.1.x / 6.3.x.
findings.verification_required: Kabir to assess exploitability of the Tomcat/Security advisories against this config; Meera to run full suite on the upgraded pom.
findings.reproduction: POST https://api.osv.dev/v1/querybatch with the Maven coordinates above.

findings.title: influora-ai pins pyjwt 2.10.1 and python-multipart 0.0.20 with known advisories; CI Python (3.11) differs from runtime image (3.13)
findings.evidence: influora-ai/requirements.txt: pyjwt[crypto]==2.10.1 (OSV: 13 ids incl. PYSEC-2025-183), python-multipart==0.0.20 (OSV: 14 ids incl. GHSA-5rvq-cxj2-64vf); pyjwt is the service-token verifier (app/auth/service_token.py), python-multipart parses /voice/transcribe uploads. .github/workflows/ai-tests.yml:33 python-version '3.11' vs influora-ai/Dockerfile FROM python:3.13-slim-bookworm. requirements.txt header says pip-audit runs in CI but no pip-audit step was found in ai-tests.yml.
findings.impact: Token verification and multipart parsing run on libraries with published advisories; tests do not exercise the interpreter that ships.
findings.recommended_fix: Bump pyjwt and python-multipart to current patched releases, add a pip-audit step to ai-tests.yml, and align CI python-version with the Dockerfile base.
findings.verification_required: pip-audit -r influora-ai/requirements.txt in CI; rerun pytest on 3.13.
findings.reproduction: OSV querybatch for PyPI pyjwt 2.10.1 / python-multipart 0.0.20.

findings.title: Unified single-instance design: per-process OAuth state, rate limits, replay nonces; single uvicorn worker; ephemeral Redis
findings.evidence: integration/meta/oauth/MetaOAuthStateStore.java:24 and ShopifyOAuthStateStore (ConcurrentHashMap); security/AuthRateLimitFilter.java:283 windows ConcurrentHashMap; security/NonceCache.java:24; influora-ai/Dockerfile CMD '--workers 1'; compose redis command '--save "" --appendonly no'; no resource limits on any service; utho-shared header describes a 7.3 GB box shared with another product and n8n.
findings.impact: A second API replica (or a rolling deploy) breaks Meta/Shopify OAuth callbacks that land on the other node and halves auth rate limiting and HMAC replay protection; no headroom for load on a shared VPS.
findings.recommended_fix: Move OAuth state, rate-limit windows and nonce cache to the Redis already in the stack (once PRI-01 is fixed), or document and enforce single-replica with sticky deploys; set mem_limit/cpus per service.
findings.verification_required: Run two API replicas behind Caddy and complete a Meta OAuth connect.

findings.title: Images published on every main push with no test gate and deployed as :latest
findings.evidence: .github/workflows/publish-images.yml: on.push.branches main (paths influora-api/**, influora-ai/**, src/**); jobs api/ai/web have no needs: on backend-tests/ai-tests/frontend-checks; influora-api/Dockerfile runs mvn -DskipTests package; every compose uses ghcr.io/.../influora-{api,ai,web}:latest although a :${github.sha} tag is also pushed.
findings.impact: A red commit on main becomes the next :latest; the running version is not identifiable and rollback means guessing a sha.
findings.recommended_fix: Make publish-images a workflow_run on successful test workflows (or a single pipeline with needs:), and pin compose images to the sha tag via an IMAGE_TAG env var.
findings.verification_required: Push a deliberately failing test on a branch merge and confirm no image is published.

findings.title: No observability beyond health + console logs: no metrics, no alerting, no cross-service correlation
findings.evidence: application.yml:121-128 exposes only health, show-details never; no micrometer-registry/sentry/opentelemetry in pom.xml, requirements.txt or package.json; logback-spring.xml plain key=value console; no X-Correlation-Id/X-Request-Id propagation in integration/ai/*Client.java or influora-ai/app/clients/spring.py; WalletTopUpReconciliationJob/PayoutOrphanedDebitSweepJob signal problems only via WARN logs.
findings.impact: A missed webhook repaired by reconciliation, a stranded payout debit, an AI router that failed to import, or rising 5xx rates are visible only to someone reading docker logs.
findings.recommended_fix: Add micrometer-registry-prometheus (CTO-approved dep) and an alert on reconciliation-repair count, payout orphan count and 5xx rate; propagate correlation id on Spring->AI calls.
findings.verification_required: Scrape /actuator/prometheus on staging; trigger a reconciliation repair and confirm an alert fires.

findings.title: No database backup mechanism anywhere in the repo for the wallet/escrow ledger
findings.evidence: grep -i mysqldump/backup over deploy/, scripts/, .github/ -> only a vhost-config backup in deploy/utho/install-ai-vhost.sh:26; MySQL is a single named volume mysql_data in every compose.
findings.impact: Disk or volume loss on the shared VPS loses all wallet balances, escrow holds and invoices.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a scheduled mysqldump/xtrabackup sidecar to off-box storage (R2 bucket already provisioned) with a tested restore runbook.
findings.verification_required: Confirm with ops whether provider snapshots exist; perform a restore drill.

findings.title: influora-ai exposes /docs, /redoc, /openapi.json publicly and swallows router import failures while health stays green
findings.evidence: Live: https://ai.influora.in/docs -> 200 text/html, /openapi.json -> 200 (lists /internal/brand-safety, /internal/creator-suggestion, /internal/trendspark/*). influora-ai/app/main.py FastAPI(...) without docs_url/openapi_url=None; main.py:79-107 wraps include_router in try/except logging only; /healthz (Docker HEALTHCHECK) and /readyz do not check registered routes. routes/trend_tag.py rate-limits on request.client.host, which behind Caddy is the proxy address.
findings.impact: Free reconnaissance of internal endpoints; a broken import silently 404s brand-safety or copilot while the container reports healthy; trend-tag limiter is a shared global bucket.
findings.recommended_fix: Set docs_url=None, redoc_url=None, openapi_url=None when APP_ENV=prod; make /readyz fail when any expected router is missing; run uvicorn with --proxy-headers --forwarded-allow-ips set to the Caddy network.

findings.title: Package cycles and inverted layering in influora-api with no enforcement
findings.evidence: Import graph: service->web (328 imports, all web.dto) vs web->service 148; common->service (common/GlobalExceptionHandler.java:5 ErrorLogService); security->service (PlanGateFilter.java:6-7, AnalyticsUsageCapInterceptor.java:6-7, InternalServiceTokenFilter.java:6, OnBehalfAuthResolver.java:8); integration<->service (integration/razorpay/RazorpayWebhookController uses EscrowService, WalletTopUpService; service->integration 89). No ArchUnit in pom.xml; only architecture test is InfoBarrierTest. God classes: DealService 2523 lines, CreatorNudgeService 2357, EscrowService 1900; src/lib/api.ts 7037 lines.
findings.impact: Every change to a DTO or filter ripples through the 58k-line service layer; refactors cannot be verified structurally.
findings.recommended_fix: Move request/response DTOs to a neutral api/dto package, move RazorpayWebhookController to web, add ArchUnit (approved-deps) with layered rules to freeze current cycles and prevent new ones.
findings.verification_required: ArchUnit freeze test green on RC.

findings.title: FE ships as one 3.35 MB main chunk: 78 eager page imports, zero route-level code splitting
findings.evidence: src/App.tsx: 78 static imports from ./pages, 0 lazy(); live /assets/index-CuJLpqhw.js = 3,348,893 bytes; three, @react-three/*, remotion, @splinetool in dependencies.
findings.impact: Slow first load on Indian mobile networks for every route including login and payment pages.
findings.recommended_fix: React.lazy per route group (brand/creator/admin/marketing) and dynamic import for 3D/remotion components.
findings.verification_required: vite build chunk report: main chunk under ~500 KB.

findings.title: Contract-drift guard covers 5 of ~403 DTO records while binding is lenient and there are three FE API layers
findings.evidence: python ci/dto-drift-check.py -> 'OK 5 TS/Java pair(s)'; ~403 records under web/dto; Jackson FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES left at Boot default false (no spring.jackson in application.yml) plus 24 @JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown = true); FE layers src/lib/api.ts, src/lib/meera-api.ts, src/admin/services/api-contracts.ts (+ src/admin/utils/auditLogger.ts:70 own API_BASE).
findings.impact: A renamed DTO field renders empty UI state with no failing test or error.
findings.recommended_fix: Generate TS types from an OpenAPI spec emitted by springdoc (approved-deps) and fail CI on diff; collapse to one HTTP client with per-area modules.
findings.verification_required: Rename a field in one DTO on a branch and confirm CI fails.

findings.title: Repo hygiene / dead config: Next.js leftovers with ignoreBuildErrors, two lockfiles, committed .class scratch, 1676 tracked .proof-os files, build tools in prod dependencies
findings.evidence: next.config.mjs (typescript.ignoreBuildErrors: true) and next-env.d.ts with no next dependency; pnpm-lock.yaml beside package-lock.json (Dockerfile uses npm ci); scratch_jwks_repro/Repro.class tracked; git ls-files .proof-os/ = 1676; autoprefixer in dependencies -> npm audit --omit=dev reports browserslist high + 2 moderate.
findings.impact: Confuses agents/tools about the stack and inflates the prod dependency audit surface.
findings.recommended_fix: Delete next.config.mjs, next-env.d.ts, pnpm-lock.yaml, scratch_jwks_repro/; move autoprefixer/postcss to devDependencies; gitignore .proof-os run logs.
findings.verification_required: npm ci && vite build still green.

findings.title: Mixed Flyway versioning with out-of-order enabled: fresh databases apply migrations in a different order than production did
findings.evidence: db/migration has V1..V74 (gaps V40, V60, V66, V67) and 70+ timestamp versions V20260709155921..V20260918180000; application.yml:61 out-of-order: true. A fresh DB applies all V1..V74 before any timestamp version; prod applied them interleaved by date. The 22 MySQL Testcontainers tests (integration/dbconstraints/*, EscrowReleaseGateIntegrationTest) were skipped in this run (no Docker), so MySQL-specific schema behaviour was not verified.
findings.impact: Staging/DR restores built from empty can diverge from prod schema if any sequential migration depends on a timestamp one or vice versa.
findings.recommended_fix: Freeze on timestamp versioning only; add a CI job that migrates an empty MySQL 8.0 and diffs information_schema against a prod schema dump.
findings.verification_required: Run flyway-validate.yml and the Testcontainers suite with Docker.

findings.title: Razorpay account and VPS shared with another product: unresolvable funding webhooks are 200-acknowledged by design
findings.evidence: integration/razorpay/RazorpayWebhookController.java:189-217 dispatchFundingEvent catches ApiException TOPUP_NOT_FOUND/ESCROW_NOT_FOUND (isUnknownToThisProduct) and returns 200 with an INFO log; the same host 150.241.245.242 serves snapsby.com (certificate observed). Mitigation: WalletTopUpReconciliationJob (hourly, @SchedulerLock) repairs PENDING top-ups from the gateway.
findings.impact: A genuinely mis-routed Influora funding event is indistinguishable from another product's event except in logs; blast radius of the shared box and payment account couples both products' incidents.
findings.recommended_fix: Use a dedicated Razorpay account (or at minimum a receipt prefix check that rejects non-Influora prefixes explicitly) and move Influora to its own host before real payment volume.
findings.verification_required: Confirm with finance whether a dedicated account is feasible.
